brand.tagline: Manage your life and work from one conversation.

brand.bubbleDone: ⏰ Done. Friday, 9:00 AM. Consider it handled.

register.name: Full name

forgot.newSub: You'll be signed out everywhere and can log in with the new one.
forgot.inboxBody: If an account exists for {email}, we've sent a link to reset your password. It works for 30 minutes.
forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.sub: Enter your account email and we'll send you a reset link.
forgot.errorFailed: That didn't go through. Please try again.
forgot.errorLinkInvalid: That link is invalid or has expired. Request a fresh one below.
forgot.updatedToast: Password updated. Log in with your new password.

complete.title: Almost there
complete.sub: A couple of details Google doesn't provide.
complete.phoneHint: Optional — the number you use for WhatsApp. You can add it any time in Settings.
complete.errorTooShort: That number looks too short. Add the full number, or leave it empty for now.
complete.errorConflict: An account with this phone number already exists.
complete.errorFailed: That didn't go through. Please try again.

google.failed: Google sign-in didn't complete. Please try again.

link.connectBody: Start the connection from your settings — Amiva prefills a WhatsApp message, and sending it links your number.
link.expiredBody: This linking link has expired or was already used. Message Amiva again on WhatsApp and she'll send you a fresh one.
link.almostBody: Sign in or create your Amiva account and the WhatsApp number you just messaged from will be connected automatically.
link.onlyContinue: Only continue if you just messaged Amiva yourself. You can unlink the number any time in Settings.
link.linkBody: Connect the WhatsApp number you just messaged Amiva from to this account? Everything you do in the chat will appear here, and vice versa.
link.onlyLink: Only link a number that belongs to you. You can unlink it any time in Settings.
link.linkedToast: WhatsApp linked — anything you tell Amiva shows up here too.
link.errorExpired: This link has expired or was already used — message Amiva on WhatsApp for a fresh one.
link.errorFailed: Couldn't link right now. Please try again.

onboarding.capRemindBody: One-time and recurring reminders, delivered where you'll see them.
onboarding.capOrganiseBody: Calendar, tasks and checklists managed from one conversation.
onboarding.capRememberBody: A personal memory you control. Save once, find forever.
onboarding.welcomeTitle: Meet Amiva, your personal chief of staff
onboarding.privacyNote: Amiva only remembers what you allow, and asks before doing anything important.
onboarding.prefsSaveFailed: Couldn't save your preferences just now, you can adjust them later in Settings.
onboarding.phoneBody: Amiva delivers reminders on WhatsApp only after your number is verified. We'll send a one-time code there — nowhere else.
onboarding.phoneLater: You can verify later in Settings. Until then, nothing is sent to this number.
onboarding.errorPhoneConflict: An account with this number already exists.
onboarding.codeSentToast: Code sent to your WhatsApp number.
onboarding.codeFailedToast: Couldn't send the code just now. Please try again.
onboarding.phoneVerifiedToast: Phone verified. WhatsApp delivery is live.
onboarding.codeMismatchToast: That code didn't match. Please try again.
onboarding.calendarBody: Amiva can create events, spot conflicts and find free slots. It only requests the calendar permissions it needs, and you can disconnect any time.
onboarding.googleFailedToast: Google connection didn't complete — nothing was changed. Please try again.
onboarding.googleNotConfigured: Google connections aren't configured on this server yet — you can skip this step.
onboarding.tryDefault: Remind me to call Mum tomorrow at 6 pm
onboarding.tryFailed: I couldn't reach Amiva just now — you can try again, or skip ahead.
